Three of the four previously surviving terminal conditional credits were in windows whose final banks contained block text. No repaired bank answers have been scored. Use the complete six-dialogue, twelve-window training factorial (91 original questions, two prefixes and two terminal actions per window).

Reparse each terminal writer response after removing only a line of the form OP block: immediately before a matching explicit ACTION: OP line, allowing whitespace. Require reproduction of the archived unmodified parse, action types, success, targets, reasoning, deterministic source items and matched writer receipts. Rebuild the two banks in their original batches. Reproduce original reader prompt, top-five order, tokens and answer for every counted control. Changed prompts use the same bounded greedy BF16 reader. Record incompatible samples rather than imputing results.
credit: First probe all four previously nonzero terminal rule-2 credits. A previously weak arm that recovers the full reference after its own format repair vetoes extra selection credit. Otherwise require strict recovery with the same direction on the two repaired arms. Bound the surviving signed magnitude by the smaller absolute original and repaired difference. All old zero labels remain zero. Freeze the policy before touching any new evaluation outcomes. Refit the previous two-stage donor-only retrieval-competition model with these revised terminal labels and unchanged verified root-overlap effects, raw four-path returns and feature definitions. Compare to the old root-overlap model, raw returns alone, native, terminal PPO and donor-matched usage. Reuse the original 52-window/466-question prospective training design and exclude already started outcome windows from strictly prospective evaluation.
secondary: After probing the credited questions, measure every remaining question on both terminal actions after both possible original first actions. For each frozen policy, compute expected F1 before and after the parsing intervention under exactly the same path probabilities. Keep this mechanism diagnostic separate from a gain caused by probability placement. Formal validation and locked LoCoMo/LongMemEval-S advancement gates are unchanged.
